timecard_migration.title: Legacy timecard date migration
timecard_migration.introduction: Safely inspect, back up, migrate, verify, and restore legacy timecard dates. Every migration run and original record is retained for audit and recovery.
timecard_migration.legacy_warning: Legacy or ambiguous timecard dates require review.
timecard_migration.scan_help: This read-only scan separates canonical records, legacy timestamps, ambiguous UTC-midnight records, and records that require manual review.
timecard_migration.legacy_detected: Found {legacyCount} legacy or ambiguous records that should be reviewed.
timecard_migration.no_legacy_detected: No legacy or ambiguous timecard dates were detected.
timecard_migration.quarantined_detected: No automatically migratable dates were found, but some invalid records were quarantined for manual review. They will not be changed by the wizard.
timecard_migration.choose_title: Choose how historical values should be interpreted
timecard_migration.choose_help: This choice defines what the legacy values meant to your users. It is stored with the migration run and never inferred from a user's browser. No interpretation is selected by default.
timecard_migration.choose_method_required: Select an interpretation method before creating the preview.
timecard_migration.mode_wall_clock_help: Treat the UTC date and time components as the company wall-clock values without shifting them.
timecard_migration.mode_instant: UTC instant converted to company timezone
timecard_migration.mode_instant_help: Treat each stored timestamp as a real instant and convert it to the explicitly selected IANA timezone.
timecard_migration.mode_legacy_display: Preserve the legacy display in company timezone
timecard_migration.mode_legacy_display_help: Keep the UTC calendar date while deriving the clock in the explicit company timezone. This often matches what users of a single-timezone deployment historically saw and intended.
timecard_migration.mode_date_only_help: Keep the UTC calendar date and do not derive a start time.
timecard_migration.company_time_zone_help: Enter an explicit IANA timezone such as Australia/Brisbane. It is used for instant-in-zone and legacy-display comparisons; UTC wall-clock and date-only values are never shifted through it.
timecard_migration.time_zone_required: Enter an explicit IANA company/comparison timezone before creating the preview.
timecard_migration.start_time_omit: Do not create a start time
timecard_migration.start_time_policy_help: Date-only migrations always omit the start time. Other modes can extract it into the dedicated startTime field.
timecard_migration.method_preview_title: Preview the selected method with real data
timecard_migration.method_preview_help: This read-only sample updates when you change the method, timezone, or start-time policy. It does not create a migration run or backup.
timecard_migration.preview_help: Each row comes from a captured, immutable backup record for this run. Timezone comparisons use {timeZone}.
timecard_migration.current_display_warning: Current display shows how the existing frontend renders the timestamp in this browser. Migration results never use the browser timezone.
timecard_migration.changed_since_snapshot: Date fields changed after this record was captured for preview
timecard_migration.no_preview_rows: No records match these preview filters.
timecard_migration.cancel_run_confirmation: Cancel this preview run? Its audit history and immutable backups will be retained.
timecard_migration.backup_help: Complete originals were captured record-by-record before preview. The wizard does not change timecards until backup counts, fingerprints, and checksums pass; later edits become compare-and-swap conflicts rather than being overwritten.
timecard_migration.backup_frozen_help: The application backup is designed for conflict-safe restore. Keep a normal external MongoDB snapshot as an additional operational safeguard.
timecard_migration.backup_failed: Backup integrity checks failed. The migration remains disabled; inspect the run before trying again.
timecard_migration.export_backup_help: Download each bounded page as Meteor Extended JSON. Date and BSON-compatible type information is preserved. Repeat for every page if you want a complete offline copy.
timecard_migration.backup_table_caption: Original records retained in this backup page
timecard_migration.no_backup_rows: No backup records are available on this page.
timecard_migration.write_lock_title: Timecard writes will be temporarily locked.
timecard_migration.write_lock_help: The migration runs in small, resumable batches. New date-changing writes are blocked during each batch; an already in-flight overlap becomes a reported conflict. Compare-and-swap checks and verification are the final guard.
timecard_migration.type_migrate: Type MIGRATE exactly to enable the migration.
timecard_migration.verify_help: Verification confirms record counts, hours, canonical fields, backup fingerprints, and any conflicts or quarantined records.
timecard_migration.apply_conflicts_help: These records changed after the snapshot and were not overwritten. Review the original, proposed, and current values before deciding how to handle them.
timecard_migration.restore_help: Review exactly what would be restored for run {runId}. Records changed after migration are reported as conflicts instead of overwritten.
timecard_migration.no_restore_rows: No records are available in this restore preview.
timecard_migration.type_restore: Type RESTORE exactly to restore the migration-owned date fields.
timecard_migration.no_history: No migration runs have been created yet.
timecard_migration.history_read_only: This historical run is read-only because its status is {status}.
timecard_migration.run_unavailable: The selected migration run is no longer available. Refresh the history and try again.
